# Project Facts for the Skills — µTest++ Testing Framework

This file is owned by the project; it was created once from the
template `npm-packages-helper/templates/first-time/.github/skills/project-liquid.md`, and it is never regenerated.

The skills in `.github/skills/` read the facts of the project from
`.github/skills/project-defaults.md` (generated, with the defaults for
the organisation and the project) and from this file. Add below, under
the same heading, only what differs from the default: the text of a
heading extends the default, or overrides it where the two disagree (a
heading that says "None", or "Not applicable", removes the default). A
heading that is absent keeps the default. The headings are: Tests,
Probes, Generated Files, Files Not to Commit, Review Documents, Breaking Changes, Documentation Updates, and Paths
(see `.github/skills/README.md`).

A skill folder may also have its own `project.md`, for the rules of that
skill only; it takes precedence over this file.

## Tests

The output of each test program is compared with the reference files in
`tests/expected/{tap,txt}` (including the `-noexcept`, `-console`,
`-console-quiet`, and `-colour` variants): a change that alters the
reports, or adds or removes checks, must update them in the same commit.

A defect fix gets its regression test (usually the probe of the
finding) in the `unit` program, in `tests/sources/unit-*/`; keep the
test cases of `unit-miscellaneous` small, since the stacks of the QEMU
targets are small.

## Probes

Add `-DMICRO_OS_PLUS_MICRO_TEST_PLUS_ENABLED` to every compiler command
line of the recipe of the defaults, and run the probe with
`--reporter=human --verbose`. The `micro-os-plus/diag/trace.h` header
is optional.

- When the output matters, run the combinations of the reporter, the
  verbosity, and the output file (see "Output" in
  `design-review/project.md`), and validate every TAP output (console
  and file) with the validator of the tests, which follows TAP 14 and
  checks the plan, the test points, and the YAML blocks:

  ```sh
  "$P/p1" > "$P/p1.tap"
  node tests/scripts/validate-tap.mjs "$P/p1.tap"
  ```

- The cross compiler for the questions that depend on the target is in
  `tests/build/<configuration>/xpacks/.bin/`
  (`*-g++`).

## Review Documents

The documents in `maintenance/docs/` that may list findings:

- the reports of the review skills (see "Report Files" in
  `review-common.md`); the earlier design reviews are named
  `API-REVIEW-<n>.md` (the skill was called `api-review`); they still
  count when choosing the number of a new `DESIGN-REVIEW-<n>.md` report
  and when looking for the most recent report, and they are searched
  for the open items;

## Breaking Changes

The public API: the declarations of the umbrella header
`include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus.h` and of the public headers in
`include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/` that the applications use (the
`micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus` namespace and its `literals`,
`operators`, `utility`, and `extension` sub-namespaces, but not
`detail`).

## Documentation Updates

- Update the hand-written pages of the website that describe the
  changed API, in particular the user manual in `website/docs/user/`
  and the developer manual in `website/docs/developer/`
- Ignore the pages generated by Doxygen (`website/doxygen/` and
  `website/docs/api/`); they are regenerated separately, by the user.
- The Doxygen comments are updated with every change of the code, in
  the same edit (see the "Doxygen Documentation" section of
  `.github/copilot-instructions.md`).

## Paths

The reports and the issues may name the headers under
`include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/` by their path relative to that
folder (for example `runner.h`, `inlines/test-inlines.h`); `src/` paths
are always written in full.
